frozenDecisions: A first-party orchestrator and semantic report are the gate authority; workflow YAML only supplies hosted orchestration and evidence retention.
Merge and trusted-release profiles are separate trust domains.
Unsigned test artifacts may receive diagnostic packaged smoke but are always untrusted and release-ineligible.
Official-endpoint SCA is fail-closed and GOV-04 grants no current critical/high exception.
Secret scanning is redacted; full-history evidence requires a complete Git checkout.
Complete package inputs, including models, workflow and policy, participate in candidate identity.
Every required step executes once per run and failed evidence cannot be retried away.
Local snapshot provenance cannot satisfy final remote-enforcement acceptance.
GitHub workflow presence is insufficient without server-side ruleset and real failed/successful run evidence.
Current unsigned and vulnerable graph keeps trusted release blocked until remediation and REL-01 signing.
developerMayNot: approve critical/high exceptions on its own
claim Git history or branch protection from this local directory
reuse stale package output or retry failed steps within one run
omit models/workflow/policy from package candidate identity
